summary: Scared brings two fists up and springs them open at the chest, with wide eyes and a flinch.
handshape: S fists opening to spread hands
movement: Fists move toward center and spring open
steps: Hold two fists at your sides at chest height.
Bring them in toward your chest and spring the fingers open.
Widen your eyes, pull your head back slightly, and let your mouth open.
mistakes: Opening the hands slowly. The spring is sudden, like a startle.
